title: 第七章 装模作样第八章 苟住苟住
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 亏的是解清玄这身子不是她之前那副站着喘坐着累的报废品，她算是勉强在段莫弃站定之前，悄声从后门翻进了院。然后一手负在身后，一手揣在身前，一脸坦然地挺胸昂首站在正门后，静等段莫弃敲门。
“师尊。”段莫弃对着紧闭的大门鞠躬行礼：“弟子段莫弃前来求学。”
解清玄点点头，耐心等了三秒才挥手将大门打开。
木门滑动带出的风将晨雾从院中吹出，解清玄的白衣白发也随着流雾向着段莫弃的方向飘然抖动。
段莫弃只匆匆抬眸看了解清玄一眼，玉红色的眸子便被那片刻闪过的白影染上了几分冷清。他赶紧将头与身子伏得更低。
“见过师尊。”
解清玄微微点头算是回应，随后便潇洒转身，不带多余感情地说了句：“随我来。”
她不动声色地往后一瞥，想看看段莫弃的表情。不知道这波有没有被她装到呢？
原主的仙府不大，是个围绕山顶石潭而建的三合院。庭中几乎没有大片的院子，只有一汪清潭，潭中一座长满绿色苔藓的石头孤岛，石缝中生着一颗盆口粗的老桂树。
解清玄未曾提前来这府中踩过点，不知院中三间屋子里面什么样，不敢贸然带段莫弃进去。她见岛中桂树下有一张小方石桌，两个团铺，便想着带段莫弃去那里坐下。
解清玄踏过木桥，先行在石桌旁盘腿落座。
段莫弃迟疑半晌也赶紧跟上，走过木桥便在石桌旁站定。没有解清玄发话，他不敢随意落座。
解清玄向她身边的团铺伸伸手，请段莫弃落座：“快坐。”
她寻思，若是原主遇着这事估计连‘坐’这一个字都不愿意多说的吧。
段莫弃这谨小慎微处处有礼的样子确实讨平常长辈喜欢，但若是碰到了原主那样的性子，也确实要受不少磋磨。
“昨日可有《流云心经》参读完毕？”解清玄率先开口，脸上是一副装模作样的淡漠。
“回师尊，看过了。”段莫弃恭敬地低着头回应。
解清玄轻轻点头：“甚好，那便说说你有何参悟罢。”她要开始和男主对答案了。
若是她在初始理解上与和天赋型选手男主解释得大差不差，那她往后的自学修炼大方向应当也不会出太大问题，自己便能更放心地把所悟告诉男主。
没想到段莫弃这孩子一言不合又开始道歉：“恕徒儿愚钝……”
“流云心经口诀的前半部分徒儿还能看明白七七八八，于是便照着自己的理解将一阶心法试着运行了一遍……”他面带惭愧：“可后口诀的半部却有些晦涩难懂了。尤其是这最后一句，徒儿苦思冥想一夜都未得其中奥义。若是不能参透这最后一句恐怕整本功法都无法融会贯通……所以……”
他身子一动，竟又在团铺上跪下了：“还请师尊解惑！”
‘不是……’解清玄心中扶额，‘他这不是又把问题给退回来了！还用的是这种跳脸方法让她没法拒绝！’
流云心法运行本就是她靠着原主的肌肉记忆参悟的，只能意会没法言传，现在又单拎出来一句，让她个工科狗现场“中译中”解释文言文，她怎么可能说得出来啊？？？
思来想去她只能使出万能对策，假装面色凝重故作高深地……实话实说：“只可意会，不可言传！”
段莫弃顿时眼帘低垂似是有些失望，他羽毛般的睫毛颤了颤，又抬起眼眸顺从道：“是，师尊……是徒儿愚钝，多嘴了……”
看着他那隐忍着委屈的表情解清玄的心好似被踹了一脚。
content_en:
Fortunately, Xie Qingxuan's body was not a scrap like the one she had worn out from standing and panting, so she managed to sneak into the courtyard through the back door quietly before Duan Moqi could stand still. Then he put one hand behind his back and the other in front of him, stood behind the front door with his chest raised and his head raised calmly, waiting quietly for Duan Moqi to knock on the door.
"Master." Duan Moqi bowed to the closed door: "Disciple Duan Moqi has come to study."
Xie Qingxuan nodded and waited patiently for three seconds before waving his hand to open the door.
The wind brought by the sliding wooden door blew the morning mist out of the courtyard, and Xie Qingxuan's white clothes and white hair also fluttered and trembled in the direction of Duan Moqi with the flowing mist.
Duan Moqi only hurriedly raised his eyes to look at Xie Qingxuan, and his jade-red eyes were somewhat deserted by the flash of white shadow at that moment. He quickly lowered his head and body lower.
"I've met Master."
Jie Qingxuan nodded slightly in response, then turned around calmly and said without any unnecessary emotion: "Come with me."
She glanced back calmly, wanting to see Duan Moqi's expression. I wonder if she has faked this wave?
The original owner's fairy mansion was not big, it was a three-sided courtyard built around a stone pool on the top of a mountain. There is almost no large yard in the courtyard, only a clear pool. In the pool is an isolated stone island covered with green moss, and an old osmanthus tree with a thick mouth grows in the crack of the stone.
Xie Qingxuan had never visited the mansion before. He didn't know what the three rooms in the courtyard were like, so he didn't dare to take Duan Moqi in rashly. She saw a small square stone table and two group bunks under the osmanthus tree on the island, so she thought about taking Duan Moqi to sit there.
Xie Qingxuan stepped across the wooden bridge and sat down cross-legged at the stone table.
Duan Moqi hesitated for a while and hurriedly followed. He walked across the wooden bridge and stood next to the stone table. He didn't dare to sit down casually without Jie Qingxuan speaking.
Jie Qingxuan stretched out his hand to the tuanpu beside her and asked Duan Moqi to take a seat: "Sit down quickly."
She thought, if the original owner encountered this problem, he probably wouldn't even be willing to say the word "sit".
Duan Moqi's cautious and polite demeanor is indeed liked by ordinary elders, but if he encounters the temperament of the original owner, he will indeed have to suffer a lot.
"Did you finish reading the Liuyun Heart Sutra yesterday?" Xie Qingxuan spoke first, with a pretentious indifference on his face.
"Return to Master, I've seen it." Duan Moqi responded with his head bowed respectfully.
Xie Qingxuan nodded lightly: "Very good, then tell me what you have learned." She was about to start to answer the question with the male protagonist.
If her initial understanding is quite similar to that of the male protagonist who is a talented player, then there should be no big problems with her future self-study and practice, and she will be able to tell the male protagonist what she has learned more safely.
Unexpectedly, Duan Moqi started to apologize again when he disagreed: "I'm sorry for my stupidity..."
"My disciple could still understand the first half of the formula of the Liuyun Heart Sutra, so I tried to run the first-level mental method according to my own understanding..." He said with a look of shame, "But the second half of the formula was a bit obscure. Especially the last sentence. I thought hard all night and still couldn't understand the secret. If I can't understand the last sentence, I'm afraid I won't be able to understand the entire technique... so..."
He moved and knelt down on the bunk again: "Master, please clarify my doubts!"
"..."
'No...' Xie Qingxuan raised his eyebrows in his heart, 'Didn't he return the question again! He even used this face-dancing method to make her unable to refuse! ’
She had understood the operation of Liuyun Mind Technique by relying on the muscle memory of the original owner. She could only understand it but could not express it in words. Now, she was asked to translate a classical Chinese text from Chinese to Chinese on the spot and asked her, an engineering dog, to interpret it. How could she possibly be able to say it? ? ?
"This...this sentence..."
After thinking about it, she could only resort to all possible countermeasures, pretending to be solemn and profound...tell the truth: "It can only be understood, not expressed in words!"
Duan Moqi suddenly lowered his eyes as if he was a little disappointed. His feather-like eyelashes trembled, and then he raised his eyes and said submissively: "Yes, Master... I am a stupid disciple and talk too much..."
Seeing his expression of forbearing grievance, Xie Qingxuan felt as if his heart had been kicked.
